menu.title: Mission control
rules.title: How to play
rules.1: Set your wager (and an optional auto-eject target) while boarding is open.
rules.2: At launch the multiplier climbs from 1.00× and keeps accelerating.
rules.3: Eject any time to collect wager × multiplier.
rules.4: If the rocket explodes before you eject, the wager is lost.
fair.title: Provably fair
fair.how: Before each launch the server publishes SHA-256(seed). After the explosion it reveals the seed, and this page recomputes the crash point itself. Select any launch in the history to check it.
fair.checkCommit: SHA-256(seed) matches the commitment published before launch
fair.checkCrash: Your browser computed the crash point: {c}
fair.mock: Mock mode replays a sample seed, so this check is expected to fail. Play against the server to verify real launches.
odds.title: The odds
odds.note: Return to player is {rtp} (house edge {edge}). The chance of reaching a multiplier m is {rtp} ÷ m, so no eject target changes the long-run return. About {instant} of launches explode at 1.00×. The maximum is {max}.
play.title: Play responsibly
play.body: Credits are play money with no cash value. Every launch is independent: past results do not predict the next one.
play.reality: A reality check appears every {n} minutes.

reality.body: You have been playing for {n} minutes: {r} launches, session result {net} credits.

tx.title: Transparency
tx.rng: Each launch's crash point comes from a fresh 256-bit seed drawn with a cryptographically secure RNG, mixed with HMAC-SHA256. It is fixed before boarding opens.
tx.rtp: Over the long run {rtp} of all credits wagered is paid back ({edge} house edge). The chance of reaching m× is {rtp} ÷ m, so no eject target changes the return; the edge shows up as about {instant} of launches exploding at 1.00×.
tx.server: The server alone decides the crash point and judges every eject by the moment it arrives. This page only animates what the server reports.
tx.auto: Runs on the server at exactly your target, even if your connection drops.
tx.idem: Every bet and eject carries a unique key. A retried request returns the original result and is never applied twice.
tx.curve: m(t) = e^({k}·t), the curve Bustabit uses: every doubling takes the same {d} s, so 10× arrives after {t10} s and 100× after {t100} s. The maximum is {max}.
cheat.notFlying: Test cheat works only while the rocket is flying.
cheat.off: Test cheats are off. Start the server with ASCENT_DEV_CHEATS=1.
errors.REFILL_NOT_NEEDED: Play credits can be refilled only when you cannot afford the minimum bet.
